mapper.select: select a.robot_id robotId, a.robot_code robotCode, a.robot_name robotName, a.robot_status robotStatus, a.last_online_time lastOnlineTime, a.off_line_count offLineCount, a.duration from t_robot_info a where 1 = 1 and a.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.robot_code = #{robotCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT tci.record_id as recordId, tci.`camera_id` cameraId, tci.camera_name cameraName, channel_num channelNum, TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(tci.commission_date) + 1 commissionDay, ( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT( updr.`createtime`, '%Y-%m-%d' ) ) ) cruiseDay, SUM(IF (updr.cruise_result = 247, 1, 0)) AS lossNum, COUNT(updr.cruise_data_id) totalNum FROM t_camera_info tci LEFT JOIN `t_camera_preset` tcp ON tci.`camera_id` = tcp.`camera_id` LEFT JOIN `t_cruise_point_instance` tcpi ON tcp.`preset_id` = tcpi.`cruise_id` LEFT JOIN `u_patrol_data_result` updr ON updr.`instance_id` = tcpi.`instance_id` AND updr.cruise_time IS NOT NULL AND updr.cruise_time > tci.commission_date WHERE 1 = 1 and tci.`commission_date` <= now() and tcp.camera_id = #{cameraId, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY cameraId
LIMIT #{startIndex},#{endIndex}

SELECT tr.robot_id robotId, tr.robot_code robotCode, tr.robot_name robotName, tr.commission_date commissionDate, TO_DAYS(CURDATE()) currentDays, TO_DAYS(CURDATE()) - TO_DAYS(tr.`commission_date`) commissionDays, COUNT( DISTINCT DAY(tcdr.`createtime`) ) cruiseDay FROM t_robot_info tr JOIN t_robot_info ON tr.robot_id = t_robot_info.robot_id AND tr.commission_date <= NOW() AND tr.robot_type IS TRUE AND tr.commission_date IS TRUE LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection tri ON tri.robot_id = tr.robot_id LEFT JOIN `t_cruise_point_instance` tcpi ON tcpi.cruise_id = tri.inspection_id LEFT JOIN `u_patrol_data_result` updr ON updr.`cruise_id` = tcpi.`instance_id` AND tr.commission_date <= updr.`createtime` WHERE 1=1 and tr.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY robotId

SELECT robot_id robotId FROM t_robot_info tr where tr.commission_date <= NOW()
AND tr.robot_type IS TRUE
AND tr.drone_type IS TRUE
AND tr.commission_date IS TRUE

SELECT tr.robot_id robotId, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(ta.alarm_time)) normalDay FROM t_robot_alarm ta JOIN t_robot_info tr ON tr.robot_id = ta.robot_id WHERE ta.alarm_time >= tr.commission_date OR ta.alarm_time IS NULL and tr.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY robotId

SELECT tr.robot_id robotId, tr.robot_code robotCode, tr.robot_name robotName, tr.commission_date commissionDate, TO_DAYS(CURDATE()) currentDays, TO_DAYS(CURDATE()) - TO_DAYS(tr.`commission_date`) commissionDays, COUNT( DISTINCT DAY(tcdr.`createtime`) ) cruiseDay FROM t_robot_info tr JOIN t_robot_info ON tr.robot_id = t_robot_info.robot_id AND tr.commission_date <= NOW() AND tr.drone_type IS TRUE AND tr.commission_date IS TRUE LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection tri ON tri.robot_id = tr.robot_id LEFT JOIN `t_cruise_point_instance` tcpi ON tcpi.cruise_id = tri.inspection_id LEFT JOIN `u_patrol_data_result` tcdr ON tcdr.`cruise_id` = tcpi.`instance_id` AND tr.commission_date <= tcdr.`createtime` WHERE 1=1 and tr.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY robotId

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(execute_time, '%Y-%m') MONTH, SUM(IFNULL(task_state = 240, 0)) AS validNum, SUM( IFNULL(task_state IN (240, 242, 243, 244), 0) ) AS totalNum FROM u_patrol_result where execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by MONTH

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(execute_time, '%u') + 1 WEEK, SUM(IFNULL(task_state = 240, 0)) AS validNum, SUM( IFNULL(task_state IN (240, 242, 243, 244), 0) ) AS totalNum FROM u_patrol_result where execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by WEEK

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(execute_time, '%Y-%m-%d') DAY, SUM(IFNULL(task_state = 240, 0)) AS validNum, SUM( IFNULL(task_state IN (240, 242, 243, 244), 0) ) AS totalNum FROM u_patrol_result where execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY DAY

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.`warn_time`, '%u') + 1 WEEK, COUNT(1) AS totalNum, COUNT(t.deal_type) AS validNum FROM (SELECT deal_type, warn_time FROM t_warn_info UNION ALL (SELECT deal_type, defect_time warn_time FROM t_defect_info)) t WHERE t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY WEEK

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.`warn_time`, '%Y-%m') MONTH, COUNT(1) AS totalNum, COUNT(t.deal_type) AS validNum FROM (SELECT deal_type, warn_time FROM t_warn_info UNION ALL (SELECT deal_type, defect_time warn_time FROM t_defect_info)) t WHERE t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY MONTH

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.`warn_time`, '%Y-%m-%d') day, COUNT(1) AS totalNum, COUNT(t.deal_type) AS validNum FROM (SELECT deal_type, warn_time FROM t_warn_info UNION ALL (SELECT deal_type, defect_time warn_time FROM t_defect_info)) t WHERE t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY day

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.warn_time, '%u') + 1 WEEK, count(1) as totalNum, sum(if(t.deal_type = 286, 1, 0)) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info where deal_type is not null union all (select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info where deal_type is not null)) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by WEEK

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.warn_time, '%Y-%m') MONTH, count(1) as totalNum, sum(if(t.deal_type = 286, 1, 0)) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info where deal_type is not null union all (select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info where deal_type is not null)) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by MONTH

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.warn_time, '%Y-%m-%d') day, count(1) as totalNum, sum(if(t.deal_type = 286, 1, 0)) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info where deal_type is not null union all (select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info where deal_type is not null)) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by day

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(detail.cruise_time, '%Y-%m') MONTH, count(1) AS totalNum, SUM( IF ( detail.cruise_status = 252, 0, 1 ) ) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_task tct LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result detail ON detail.task_id = tct.task_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY MONTH

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(detail.cruise_time, '%u') + 1 WEEK, count(1) AS totalNum, SUM( IF ( detail.cruise_status = 252, 0, 1 ) ) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_task tct LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result detail ON detail.task_id = tct.task_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY WEEK

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( detail.cruise_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) DAY, count(1) AS totalNum, SUM( IF ( detail.cruise_status = 252, 0, 1 ) ) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_task tct LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result detail ON detail.task_id = tct.task_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY DAY

SELECT count(1) AS totalNum, SUM( IF ( detail.cruise_status = 252, 0, 1 ) ) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_task tct LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result detail ON detail.task_id = tct.task_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and detail.task_id = #{taskId} and tct.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT( result.cruise_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) DAY, count(1) AS totalNum, count(result.identify_result) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_data_result result WHERE result.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY DAY

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(result.cruise_time, '%u') + 1 WEEK, count(1) AS totalNum, count(result.identify_result) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_data_result result WHERE result.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY WEEK

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(result.cruise_time, '%Y-%m') MONTH, count(1) AS totalNum, count(result.identify_result) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_data_result result WHERE result.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY MONTH
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(tcr.execute_time, '%Y-%m-%d') day, count(1) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_result tcr WHERE tcr.execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by day
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(tcr.execute_time, '%u') + 1 week, count(1) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_result tcr WHERE tcr.execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by week
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(tcr.execute_time, '%Y-%m') month, count(1) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_result tcr WHERE tcr.execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(tct.execute_time, '%Y-%m-%d') DAY, SUM(timestampdiff(MINUTE, tct.execute_time, tct.end_time )) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_result tct WHERE tct.execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY DAY

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(tct.execute_time, '%u') + 1 week, SUM(timestampdiff(MINUTE, tct.execute_time, tct.end_time )) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_result tct WHERE tct.execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY week

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(tct.execute_time, '%Y-%m') month, SUM(timestampdiff(MINUTE, tct.execute_time, tct.end_time )) AS validNum FROM u_patrol_result tct WHERE tct.execute_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY month
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(defect_time, '%Y-%m-%d') DAY, defect_content as 'defectType', COUNT(1) AS count FROM t_defect_info WHERE defect_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY defectType,DAY
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(defect_time, '%u') + 1 week, defect_content as 'defectType', COUNT(1) AS count FROM t_defect_info WHERE defect_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY defectType,week
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(defect_time, '%Y-%m') month, defect_content as 'defectType', COUNT(1) AS count FROM t_defect_info WHERE defect_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY defectType,month

SELECT 0 as device_type, robot_id as robotId, robot_num as patrolDeviceCode, robot_name as patrolDeviceName, DATE_FORMAT(commission_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as commissionTime FROM t_robot_info WHERE robot_type IS NOT NULL
SELECT 2 as device_type, camera_id as cameraId, camera_id as patrolDeviceCode, camera_name as patrolDeviceName, DATE_FORMAT(commission_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as commissionTime FROM t_camera_info

SELECT 1 as device_type, robot_id as robotId, robot_num as patrolDeviceCode, robot_name as patrolDeviceName, DATE_FORMAT(commission_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) as commissionTime FROM t_robot_info WHERE drone_type IS NOT NULL

SELECT a.record_id as recordId, a.camera_id as cameraId, a.camera_name as cameraName, a.channel_num as channelNum, TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(a.commission_date) + 1 AS commissioDay, COUNT(DISTINCT TO_DAYS(updr.cruise_time)) AS cruiseDay, IFNULL(CONCAT(CONVERT(COUNT(DISTINCT TO_DAYS(updr.cruise_time)) / (TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(a.commission_date) + 1) * 100, DECIMAL(15, 3)), '%'), '0.000%') AS cruisePercent, SUM(IF (updr.cruise_result = 247, 1, 0)) AS lossNum, COUNT(updr.cruise_data_id) as totalNum, IFNULL(CONCAT(CONVERT(SUM(IF (updr.cruise_result = 247, 1, 0)) / COUNT(updr.cruise_data_id) * 100, DECIMAL(15, 3)), '%'), '0.000%') as lossPercent FROM t_camera_info a LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset tcp ON a.camera_id = tcp.camera_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance tcpi ON tcp.preset_id = tcpi.cruise_id LEFT JOIN u_patrol_data_result updr ON updr.instance_id = tcpi.instance_id AND updr.cruise_time IS NOT NULL AND a.commission_date <= updr.createtime WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.commission_date IS NOT NULL and tcp.camera_id = #{cameraId, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY cameraId
